(a) Reachability: the changed lines sit behind `use_sliding_window_kv_pool and not use_swa_source`; with a translating/unified pool (reads_are_translated=True) the entire translate block is skipped and the changed lines are dead code -- confirmed in 12/12 such configuration rows. (b) Index equality: host int equals cumsum(device lens)[bs] in all 32 non-control cases, including SWA-clamped lenses above the 511 window, exactly-512/513, CUDA-graph-padded zero lanes, seq_lens_cpu=None, and prefill 16x8192 and 16x(512+8192). Uncertainty: CPU integer replay of AST-extracted expressions, not a runtime measurement; the frozen launch flags (unified pool? seq_lens_cpu present?) are controller-side and not asserted; decode has no custom_kv_indices parameter, so no decode-side analogue of the prefill dq guard is required.

learning: The pending t3/t4 host mirror is a safe, narrow D2H-hygiene patch, not a performance lever. Executed facts: (a) it is dead code whenever the KV index translator reads translated ids (unified SWA pool), because use_swa_source=True skips the whole full->swa translate block; (b) outside that case it removes exactly one device read per eager decode step and zero when seq_lens_cpu is None, because update_sliding_window already materialises the sum at line 1696; (c) index equality holds for every modelled shape including SWA-clamped, graph-padded and 16x8192 prefill, with both negative controls detected. Combined with trial-1's measured 1.0018 KEPT_NEUTRAL for the sibling sync-removal family, the expected aggregate gain at the frozen gate points is ~0, so a ~1.0 Fast result for this candidate must not be read as a regression or as evidence about any other path. The deepseek-b BF16 lane has no remaining measured lever: decode is roofline-closed on a4, the long-context prefill lever (21/28 sliding layers doing full 8192^2 in extend_no_prefix) is a semantics change blocked on >512-token exact-token parity, and the MMVQ lane is provably gate-unreachable. Limits: this is a source-contract + integer oracle, not a runtime measurement; frozen launch flags are controller-side; no GPU/SSH exists here.
